payload.core_mechanism_summary: If k=1, return n; else compute the all-ones mask up to the highest bit of n using sum of powers of two, giving the maximum XOR sum achievable with ≥2 numbers.
payload.rationale: The solution exploits that with at least two distinct numbers from 1..n, one can construct a XOR sum that sets all bits up to the most significant bit of n, yielding max XOR = (1 << (floor(log2(n)) + 1)) - 1. This is a classic bit XOR maximization trick, no DP involved.
